In the Nxeon "Nexion" v2 hosting-platform codebase at /opt/nxeon-v2 (real Next.js app, real backend, dev instance at http://127.0.0.1:3021, login admin@nxeon.local / iCwEt7PDdo0ne3YM), investigate TWO separate bugs. Do not fix anything — diagnostic only.

**BUG 1 — Discord account connection appears to fail.**
The user went to Settings, clicked to connect their Discord account, got redirected to Discord's OAuth authorization page, approved it, got redirected back to Settings — and Settings still shows Discord as NOT connected.

Investigate: find the Discord OAuth flow (grep for "discord-oauth", likely lib/discord-oauth.ts, an API route under app/api/discord/*, and the Settings UI component that shows connection status, likely components/nx/SettingsView.tsx or an IntegrationsPanel component mentioned in this codebase). Trace the full flow: (a) what URL does clicking "Connect" send the user to, (b) what does the OAuth callback route do when Discord redirects back (does it actually look up/create a record, e.g. on the User model or a separate table, storing a Discord user id/token?), (c) what does the Settings UI actually check to decide whether to show "Connected" vs "Not connected" — is it reading the SAME field the callback route writes to, or a different one (a classic bug shape: callback writes to field A, UI reads field B)? (d) Check for silent errors — does the callback route have error handling that could be swallowing a real failure (wrong redirect URI configured, missing env var, a database write that silently no-ops)? Try to actually reproduce by checking server logs (journalctl equivalent, or just check what's logged in the terminal/console when a callback happens) and check the real DB for whether a Discord id got written to this admin account's row despite the UI showing "not connected" (that would confirm it's a pure UI-read bug rather than a callback failure).

**BUG 2 — "First month free" promo keeps showing even after already used.**
For shared/cloud hosting plans, the "FIRST MONTH FREE" badge/messaging should disappear once a customer has already redeemed it once (this session's own code comments earlier referenced `lib/promo-redemption.ts` and a `hostingFirstMonthFreeCents` / `firstMonthFreeEligible`-style eligibility check that's supposed to gate this exactly). Investigate: find every PLACE in the UI that displays "First month free" / "FIRST MONTH FREE" messaging for hosting (plan cards in the deploy wizard, hosting page marketing badges, etc.) and check whether each one actually calls the real eligibility check (lib/promo-redemption.ts's firstMonthFreeEligible or equivalent) or whether some of them just unconditionally show the badge as static marketing copy regardless of the signed-in customer's real eligibility. If eligibility IS checked in some places but not others, that inconsistency is the bug. Also check: does the eligibility check actually get INVALIDATED/turned off correctly once a customer places a hosting order (i.e., does a real DB write happen marking the promo as used for that account), or does the check have a bug in its "already used" condition (e.g. checking the wrong service type, wrong table, or a condition that's structurally always true/false)?

Report back precisely for both bugs: exact file:line references for the actual root cause, and a precise minimal fix recommendation (before/after snippet) for each, but do not apply anything. Under 600 words total for both bugs combined.

Here's the diagnosis for both bugs. ## Bug 1 — Discord "connect" doesn't stick The write and the read *do* target the same field (`User.discordUserId`, `prisma/schema.prisma:144`), and the sandbox DB confirms it: `admin@nxeon.local`'s `discordUserId` is genuinely NULL — this is a real callback failure, not a UI-read mismatch. **Root cause:** `app/api/discord/callback/route.ts`'s `handleLinkCallback` (lines 94-127) has multiple `fail(...)` branches (not-signed-in, bad state, code-exchange failure, lookup failure, unique-conflict) that all redirect to `redirectWith({ discord: "error", discordmsg: ... })` (lines 87-92) — appending `?discord=error&discordmsg=...` to the Settings URL. But `components/nx/IntegrationsPanel.tsx`'s `DiscordCard` and `components/nx/SettingsView.tsx` **never read that query string** — no `useEffect`/`searchParams` handling exists there (confirmed by grep: zero matches for `discordmsg`/`window.location` in those files). Compare this to the staff equivalent, `components/admin/DiscordIntegration.tsx:32-51`, which explicitly parses `?discord=connected|error&discordmsg=` in a `useEffect` and shows a banner. The customer flow has no such code, so whatever real error occurred server-side is completely swallowed — the customer just lands back on Settings seeing plain "Not connected," with the actual reason invisible. Contributing: this sandbox has no `DISCORD_*` env vars and no `discord_*` Settings rows (`getSetting("discord_application_id"...)` empty), so `discordOauthConfigured()` is false — worth confirming which failure branch actually fires in your environment via the (currently discarded) `discordmsg`. **Minimal fix:** port the admin `DiscordIntegration.tsx` `useEffect` pattern (lines 32-51) into `IntegrationsPanel.tsx`'s `DiscordCard`, reading/clearing `discord`/`discordmsg` from `window.location.search` and rendering it via the existing `` component — so a real failure becomes visible instead of a silent "Not connected." ## Bug 2 — "First month free" badge ignores real eligibility Eligibility computation itself is correct: `app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx:56-69` calls `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo/Enabled/Eligible` per-customer and builds `hostingFirstMonthFreeCents` (line 251: `hostingPromoEligible ? h.priceCents : 0`), which flows into the real quote engine at `components/nx/order.tsx:282` (`cat.hostingFirstMonthFreeCents[...] ?? 0`) — the actual charge is correct. `HostingDeployWizard.tsx:762` also correctly gates its badge on `firstMonthFree && creditCents > 0`. **Root cause:** `components/nx/DeployView.tsx:1440-1446` — the "First month free" pill on the service-selection tile: ```tsx {s.key === "hosting" && ( First month free )} ``` This checks only `s.key === "hosting"`, never consulting `hostingFirstMonthFreeCents`/`hostingPromoEligible`, even though that data is already threaded down as a prop (`order-types.ts`/`order.tsx:111`) and used correctly elsewhere in the same tree. Confirmed by grep: `hostingFirstMonthFreeCents` never appears anywhere in `DeployView.tsx`. So this one badge shows unconditionally for every signed-in customer regardless of prior redemption. **Minimal fix:** ```tsx // before {s.key === "hosting" && ( // after {s.key === "hosting" && Object.values(cat.hostingFirstMonthFreeCents ?? {}).some((c) => c > 0) && ( ``` (or thread a single `hostingPromoEligible: boolean` prop down and check that directly, mirroring `HostingDeployWizard.tsx`'s `firstMonthFree` flag).
